capabilities: connect to a Calibre Content server from a vault
browse and access Calibre libraries in an Obsidian view
read books in panes while taking notes
open multiple panes to read several books at once
configure the content server address and port
extras: The view works by embedding the server interface in an iframe; the README points to the Calibre documentation for the Content server and has no screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to access a Calibre library or read ebooks while taking notes in the same workspace.

relations.evidence: This is a calibre Content server plugin for Obsidian. Allow you to access your calibre libraries

summary: Client for the Calibre Content server that opens your ebook libraries and reads books inside Obsidian panes.
